readbacks.readback: For every element $x$ of the specified algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbb Q}$ of $\mathbb Q$, if the natural-number degree of its minimal polynomial over $\mathbb Q$ is at most $1$, then there exists a rational number $q$ such that $x$ equals the image of $q$ under the canonical embedding $\mathbb Q\hookrightarrow\overline{\mathbb Q}$. The degree bound is inclusive; although it syntactically permits degree $0$, every element of this algebraic closure has a minimal polynomial of positive degree. The declaration has no variable universe, arbitrary field, or additional typeclass hypothesis.
